fieldValues.title: The SRS compass works because it is consulted at the point of decision; the fractal compass has the structure but no such check
fieldValues.summary: The SRS decision compass (srs/docs/charter/decision-compass.md, since 2026-08-23) settles spec decisions: every RFC passes the Charter Check (rfc skill Stage 1.5, checker-enforced: cells, decision mode, one-way-per-goal, layer test), the level test relocates a rule to the level that owns it, a drift guard binds the page to its 19 charter rulings, and 41 of 54 rfc-decision records cite a cell, axis or the compass. The fractal compass in srs-programme has the structure (25 domains, 24 axis-in-domain records, 66 tensions, 112 poles, 39 principles; Semantic records, Stance and Programme coordination have 3 of 3 axes affirmed) but nothing consults it when a decision is made: 13 domains, including all nine work-flow stages, have 0 of 3 affirmed axes of their own, and 8 of 109 programme decisions are set against a principle or decision.
evidence: srs/docs/charter/decision-compass.md (Pattern Grid, axis and cell preferences, layer rules, level test, decision modes, three doors)
grep of srs rfc-decision records for compass, cell or axis: 41 of 54 (2026-10-28)
clerk domains and clerk check on srs-programme, 2026-10-28
srs-programme relations: set-against 8 (5 to decisions, 3 to principles)
fieldValues.body:
- Do not mix the lenses (owner, vignette cad03157). The compass is a 3x4 grid: four elements crossed with three levels (Individual, Relational, Systemic). Its modalities, Cardinal, Fixed and Mutable, run on the diagonals, and these correspond to the fractal's three lines. The compass levels are a different lens from the lines. Each of the six compass axes pairs opposite cells, which share a modality, so each line holds the two axes on one diagonal. The domain Semantic records places them that way only on its Change line (finding, 2026-10-28).
- What travels is the mechanism, not the content: a check at the point of decision, a cited cell or axis on every ruling, a level test with relocate, retire or hold, and a drift guard.
- The level test (rfc-decision-c20fcff8) is the placement step of the decision flow (stage D3) already ruled for the spec.
